strings.patient_bundles.patient_yoshizawa_miho.p: Miho Yoshizawa
“Hospitalization... is it? I will follow your arrangements. Only... could you tell me roughly how long I will need to stay? I need to put things in order at the house first.”
“Understood, I will stay. I will explain things to the painter myself... please don't trouble yourself over me.”
“I'm sorry, I would like to confirm something... The operation explained earlier seems to have a different name from the one mentioned just now. Did I mishear?”
“Thank you for explaining it so clearly. As long as I know what will happen next, I don't have to keep guessing.”
“Yes... I will cooperate. Um, forgive me for asking one more thing, but is the next step an examination, or is the surgery about to begin?”
“Doctor, I will try my best to stay composed... If I cannot answer right away, could you please ask me once more?”
“General anesthesia... Once I fall asleep, I won't know anything at all, will I? If someone could tell me it is over when I wake up, I would feel much more at ease.”
“Epidural anesthesia... I will stay awake while part of my body cannot move, is that right?... Understood, I will try my best not to panic.”
“With local anesthesia, I will still be able to speak, won't I? If it feels uncomfortable inside... I will do my best to tell you instead of holding it in silently.”
“Without anesthesia...? I'm sorry, I thought I should agree to what is asked of me... but having surgery directly like that truly frightens me.”
“...Thank you. I will close my eyes now. I leave everything else in your hands...”
“Ugh... it hurts...! Please wait... I'm not trying to be uncooperative, I truly, truly cannot keep enduring this...!”
“I'm sorry, I can't stop trembling... Please don't grab hold of me all of a sudden. If you tell me first, I will do my best to follow.”
“I know I need to hold this posture... it's just that the pulling sensation a moment ago made me flinch without meaning to. Please give me a little time.”
“...So I really cannot move on my own. If you need to adjust my position, could you tell me beforehand? It's a little frightening when I cannot see.”
“I will cooperate... Ah, wait! That blade... it's already right above my body... Please, don't bring it down yet...!”
“...Has it already begun? There isn't the sharp pain I imagined, yet that pressure... knowing my own body is being cut open still makes me feel cold inside...”
“Ugh...! The surface feels numb, but that sensation inside just now... Doctor, I can still feel it—please hear me out...!”
“Aaah—! It hurts so much...! I'm sorry, please stop for a moment! It really hurts... I cannot lie here quietly anymore...!”
“You stopped... Thank you very much. Let me catch my breath first... a moment ago I couldn't even finish asking for help.”
“Yes, I heard you, I must stay still... but my body keeps shaking. Please don't be angry with me, I really am trying...!”
“...Are we continuing again? Please let me know first—I would like to take one more deep breath.”
“Thank you for telling me how it's progressing. When I only hear the sound of instruments, I keep wondering if something has gone wrong...”
“...Miss Nurse, are you checking whether I'm uncomfortable? Could you please stay right here a little longer...?”
“...Doctor? Why did everyone's voices suddenly stop... I-is everything still going smoothly?”
“It's really almost over...? Thank goodness... Thank you for patiently telling me what was happening the whole time.”
“All right... breathe in, and slowly breathe out. I will follow your voice and stop trying to endure it blindly on my own.”
“...I don't have the strength to say much anymore. Please go ahead... when it is finished, just call my name softly.”
“An enema... is part of today's preparation as well? I understand. Could you please explain how I should cooperate first...?”
“Forgive me, just thinking about it makes me feel rather embarrassed. Please draw the curtain closed... I will do as the nurse says.”
“Usually I am the one preparing things for others... Having to trouble you with such personal care today feels very unfamiliar to me.”
“An enema isn't needed this time... is it?... That's a slight relief. Thank you for letting me know.”
“Understood—we won't do steps that aren't needed. I was worrying about it earlier... it seems I was overthinking.”
“Skin prep is needed too...? The area is around here... I understand, please let me straighten the blanket first.”
“...So the hair has to be shaved. I will cooperate, only could you please speak a little slowly? I'm rather nervous.”
“It isn't that I mind troubling you... I have simply rarely let anyone tend to me like this, so I feel quite bashful.”
“Skin prep isn't needed this time... is that right?... Thank you, I was just worrying whether I could stay composed.”
“Understood. Since the preoperative plan doesn't require it, I won't ask any further... Phew.”
“All of my hair needs to be tucked inside the cap... All right. Excuse me, is it put on properly like this?”
“In the mirror I suddenly look like a different person... I really am about to enter the operating room as a patient.”
“A lock of hair is still sticking out? I'm sorry... could I trouble you to check it for me once more?”
“My arms here, and my body turned a little further... All right, I will do as you say.”
“This posture makes me feel a little uneasy... may I adjust slightly? I will keep cooperating.”
“If the anesthesia keeps me from moving on my own later, please let me know in advance how you will position my body.”
“With no anesthesia at all... I still have to stay completely still like this? I want to say yes, but in truth I'm not confident I can...”
“Miss Nurse, if I flinch from the pain... please don't think I am trying to cause trouble on purpose.”
“Please wait a moment... I am still trembling. Securing my body like this right now—does it mean we are starting immediately?”
“Urinary catheterization as well... I understand. Could you please tell me the steps beforehand rather than starting all of a sudden...?”
“Having someone tend to me in this way is truly... very embarrassing. Please draw the curtain shut, if you would.”
“I will try my best to relax. If it feels uncomfortable, may I tell you directly...?”
“Doing this preparation without any anesthesia... I'm sorry, even this step alone makes me feel frightened right now...”
“Miss Nurse... please don't rush. Knowing that the operation itself comes right after this, the more I think about it, the less I can relax.”
“Yes, I will listen to you... but if it hurts, please let me say so instead of making me hold it in the whole time.”
“Ah... it's so cold. That's the antiseptic, isn't it? I'm sorry, it startled me.”
“The area is larger than I imagined... Understood, I will hold my posture and stay still.”
“Is the disinfection finished already...? Does that mean the scalpel is the very next step...?”
“Just the antiseptic touching my skin makes me this tense... What am I going to do when it truly begins...”
“Doctor, please say one more word to me... Not being able to see the instruments over there makes me even more afraid.”
“This is the mark for where you will cut... I understand. Seeing it drawn on my own body still leaves me feeling very uneasy...”
“Is the line finished?... If I start trembling, please remind me to breathe slowly.”
“Without anesthesia... you're going to cut right along here?... I-I understand, but I'm so scared...”
“That line is right there on my skin... I want to pretend I don't see it, yet I cannot look away at all.”
“I'm sorry, could you please hold off on bringing the scalpel over for just a moment...? I still cannot stop shaking.”
Doctor... I am not very good at explaining things about myself. What feels unwell with my body today is: {line}
The most noticeable problem... should be this: {line}. If I haven't explained it clearly enough, please ask me again.
Also... please make a note of one more thing: {line}. Forgive me, I hesitated for a long time before deciding to mention it.

My name is Miho Yoshizawa. I was taken in by an elderly painter when I was a child, and since reaching adulthood I have worked as a maid in his household. I spend almost all of my time working indoors and rarely have occasion to interact with people outside... coming to the hospital on my own makes me somewhat nervous.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_yoshizawa_miho.e: “...Do I need to take off all my clothes for the examination? I will cooperate... only, standing in front of someone like that is something I am really not used to. Could you tell me first what part you need to examine?”
“We won't do this part for now... is that right?... That is a relief. Still, if it is truly necessary, please don't leave out an examination just because I am shy.”
“Yes... I understand. Could you please draw the curtain closed first and give me a moment?”
“Thank you for explaining it clearly first... I will get ready slowly on my own. If I become too nervous, please remind me gently.”
“...Please don't speak to me like that. I wasn't trying to avoid the examination... it's just that the more I am rushed, the less I know what to do.”
strings.patient_bundles.patient_yoshizawa_miho.p: Preoperative Preparation of Miho Yoshizawa
“Dr. Sakaguchi... am I really having surgery today? I have already put matters at the house in order. Could you please tell me once more how everything will be arranged from here?”

“Um... may I ask in a little more detail? Once I am on the operating table later, from positioning and disinfection to the actual incision, which step comes first...? I'm afraid I won't dare to speak up then.”

Just as she normally listens to her master's household instructions, Miho keeps her head bowed and listens attentively to every explanation, answering in a quiet voice from time to time. Yet as the medical staff explain the incision, instruments, and intraoperative procedures, her fingers slowly clench the bedsheet. All those steps that once sounded like distant medical terms are about to happen to her own body; at last she looks up, unmistakable fear showing in her eyes.

“Local anesthesia... yes. I will cooperate. If I still feel anything, may I tell you directly...?”
“...There really is no anesthesia at all. Doctor... I know it was explained earlier, but seeing the instruments right now is making me afraid all over again...”
